text:
elena: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of slow metric tiles in the EU console canary about 10m after we changed routing weights. LCP p95 jumped from ~1.1s to ~2.4s.

mike: ugh. Which routing tweak? the backend affinity change from this morning?

elena: yeah, we shifted more traffic to the low-cost pool and bumped prefetch TTL down in the policy. Charts that rely on embedlib seem worst.

sam: does telemetry show bundle parse or network? can you paste a trace?

elena: trace attached (short). shows main-thread parse + long idle on script evaluation. network still served fast. suspect deferred chunking + a new embedlib import.

janet: deploy-bot just posted the canary rollout:
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-06-07T10:12 -> service/console v4.12.3 (routing-weight-update) :rocket:

nate: if it's eval time, could be new ESM import that brings in big polyfill. Any diff in bundle size between v4.12.2 -> v4.12.3?

mike: checking CI artifacts... quick grep: +360KB gzipped in the shell chunk, looks like embedlib bumped due to an optional gzip->brotli change.

sam: Hmm — we also changed prefetch behavior so some widgets now fetch a heavier chunk earlier. Combine that with an extra module and you get a cold parse spike.

elena: reproducer on my laptop when emulating slow cpu: open dashboard -> scroll -> sparkline panel freezes for ~600ms. Console shows heavy parse.

janet: can we roll the routing weight back to previous so we don't route more users to the bursty pool? I can patch the policy in 5m if ops agrees.

mike: patching routing weight rollback now (will patch canary only).

deploy-bot: routing-policy service updated for canary: weight_eu_lowcost = 0.25 -> 0.65 by mike at 1759998950

nate: temporary mitigation ideas: 1) revert embedlib change (easy) 2) increase prefetch threshold so heavy chunks load later 3) split the new import into a dynamic boundary.

sam: splitting or defer-loading the polyfill seems best long-term. Revert can buy time.

elena: agree — for now a rollback of the embedlib bump + routing rollback should reduce user p95. Can we coordinate?

mike: opened PR to revert the embedlib change (PR #4381). marking as hotfix.

janet: i'll watch canary p95 and open a rollback to stable if it doesn't improve in 15m.

elena: thanks. also can we add a telemetry histogram for parse time per-chunk (so rollouts show cost of parse, not just network)? hard to correlate today.

sam: +1. I'll add a lightweight metric (client: parseTimeByChunk) and a short dashboard tile.

mike: action items: mike -> revert embedlib (PR), sam -> telemetry metric + dash, janet -> monitor canary and coordinate rollback to stable, elena -> attach reproducer snippet to PR.

elena: attaching snippet here:
```js
// repro: emulate slow cpu
await page.emulateCPUThrottling(6);
await page.goto('/console?canary=true');
await page.click('[data-test=sparkline-panel]');
// measure main-thread parse pause via PerformanceObserver
```

elena: thanks team :thumbsup:

mike: rolling PR now, will post status.

deploy-bot: hotfix PR #4381 merged and deployed to canary at 1759999000

janet: canary p95 LCP -> 1.15s after rollback. tagging as resolved for now, will keep an eye overnight.

elena: great, closing the loop. follow-ups in product-telemetry channel for instrumentation work.
